title: Nothing Broke in HAL Schema Forms
kicker: The original script, at L0 and at L2
html:
Nothing Broke in HAL Schema Forms

L0, everything in one answer501, 502, 503, 505 promoted; 504 stopped by S3
L2, forms and schemas by link501, 502, 503, 505 promoted; 504 stopped by S3
Generated again from its walkthe script and its 9 pinned forms, identical line for line

The original release.heart.yaml, unchanged, replayed at both rungs after the HAL-FORMS work.
say: Making HAL-FORMS carry the release changed the servers and the generator, so the original HAL Schema Forms script was replayed again, unchanged, at L0, everything in one answer, and at L2, forms and schemas fetched by link and checked by hash. Same five releases, same four promoted, 504 stopped. Its script and pins also come out of the generator identical, line for line.

deck:ref.title: L0, L1, L2: three ways to deliver the same forms
deck:ref.summary: L0: everything in one answer. L1: the forms by link, so they are shared and cacheable. L2: the forms and their schemas by link, checked by integrity hashes, so a replay sends almost nothing it has seen before.

deck:ref.name: repeatability
deck:ref.label: REPEATABILITY
deck:ref.title: Repeatability: the same goal, the same result, every time
deck:ref.summary: Given the same inputs, the same outputs, call after call. Found once with a model, then replayed with none: the same steps, the same checks, the same result, until the controls really change. At the small scale it is one scenario that runs the same way every time.
